title: SmarterTools SmarterMail Insufficient Entropy Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-126969)
description: CVE-2026-126969 is a critical vulnerability in SmarterTools SmarterMail that allows remote attackers to bypass authentication without requiring any credentials. The flaw stems from insufficient entropy used in generating Application Passwords, enabling attackers to predict or reproduce authentication tokens and gain unauthorized access.
